environment.description: ECS Fargate service in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing) routing traffic to port 9090. Security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 9090. Kafka brokers are Amazon MSK in the same VPC. No authentication on the admin endpoint. Service discovery via public DNS.

config.kafka: Amazon MSK, same VPC, no SASL
